title: Express the complete Pose Search trajectory in the authored animation frame

e74_learning.diagnosis: Velocity was rotated into the authored frame while current and desired trajectory facing remained in the actor frame, producing an internally inconsistent query.

hypothesis: Applying one actor-centered authored-frame rotation to both trajectory velocity and facing will preserve the E74 physical-progress improvement and allow the matching MF_Unarmed_Walk_Fwd poses to beat idle.
single_behavior_change: The Pose Search predictor receives an actor-centered frame rotation derived from the inverse mesh-relative rotation. That same rotation is applied to current velocity, future velocity, current facing, and desired facing. Actor position remains the trajectory origin. World-space shell movement, yaw, locomotion authority velocity, policy inputs, action conditioning, gains, database assets, schema, weights, and selection policy remain unchanged.
tdd_contract: Actor yaw 0 with mesh-relative yaw -90 resolves an authored-frame rotation of +90 degrees.
The frame maps actor-forward +X to database-forward +Y and actor-facing yaw 0 to authored-facing yaw +90.
At actor yaw 30 the same mesh-relative frame maps world actor-forward to world yaw 120 and facing yaw 30 to yaw 120.
Velocity magnitude, zero velocity, quaternion normalization, and inverse roundtrip are preserved.
Components without a mesh retain the identity frame so existing pure Stage2 tests remain unchanged.
The authoritative Normal episode selects MF_Unarmed_Walk_Fwd during sustained movement without an asset-name override.
Normal physical-root projected progress is positive, exceeds ZeroActions, and final root-shell error is below ZeroActions.
The identical shell path, exact 30-degree turn, control readback, support, and stop-to-standing contracts remain valid.
rejection_rule: Reject and revert if forward locomotion is not selected, physical projected progress is nonpositive, Normal tracking is not better than ZeroActions, or any product/standing regression appears.
next_if_supported: Preregister immutable scripted-locomotion protocol v2 using measured root progress, tracking, stability, and negative-control thresholds, then run all repetitions.
